'''Grimgot Varad''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a lieutenant of [[Clan Varad]]. He was killed during the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]].<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
